general.selectFields: D4.D4_COD AS item_code, SB1.B1_DESC AS description, SB1.B1_UM AS unit, SUM({consumption_expr}) AS real_consumption_qty

branch.selectFields: D4.D4_FILIAL AS branch, D4.D4_COD AS item_code, SB1.B1_DESC AS description, SB1.B1_UM AS unit, SUM({consumption_expr}) AS real_consumption_qty
branch.orderBy: real_consumption_qty DESC, D4.D4_FILIAL ASC, D4.D4_COD ASC

product_group.selectFields: SB1.B1_GRUPO AS product_group, SUM({consumption_expr}) AS real_consumption_qty

unit.selectFields: SB1.B1_UM AS unit, SUM({consumption_expr}) AS real_consumption_qty

branch_summary.selectFields: D4.D4_FILIAL AS branch, SUM({consumption_expr}) AS real_consumption_qty
